items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Stecklet Interview, 1959-06-15
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Did you ever play with Jack Lane? INTERVIEWEE: No, I never did. ... He oft times asked me to play but I told him I'm engaged.

ctx.x: A lot of speeches you know. Have a regular big stand you know like the elections have and they get up and make speeches and that. Yeah that's what the politician is the rule. Even from all over would come in big crowds there. I thought maybe they'd turn into a dance then afterwards. No, not after that, they'd just have to play.

I wondered, Papa Lane once told me that he played to his brass band, played for funerals too. Did your brass band ever play for any funerals? No, another day. I know niggas used to have brass bands that they're

for them a regular you know. Yeah. At the nigger band. They'd be going down there when they come back it's chippy get a head cut you know. All that kind of stuff you know. Yeah stuff. But the niggas don't,
